depth_grid_note: The grid MUST respect the tier-B 1% depth cap (Claude's catch: the committed 2% trial is above the cap). Planet trials cover sub-1% depths (0.2%, 0.5%, 0.8%) + 1%; the 2%/5% depths belong to the EB class only, never to a planet trial.
description: Phase 3 injection campaign at scale (bulk screen, bulk_v3). Injects planet-like transits, eclipsing binaries, sinusoidal variables and flagged-cadence-only dips into real cached QLP light curves and screens them through the real bulk screen. Serves 3B's injection-recovery loss measurement in the 1-2-event regime (P3-11) and 3A's training set (P3-16/P3-17). The campaign DEFINITION is committed so the run is reproducible; the run's outputs (injections.jsonl, summary.json) live in run-data dirs, never in git.

effective_n.note: Row count is NOT independent examples: multiple injections into the same host are correlated observations (same noise, same systematics, same host signal). The campaign reports n_hosts as the independent unit alongside n_trials; the same TIC injected in two sectors counts once toward effective-n.

expected_counts.note: planet_like_positives = 9/host (8 planet + 1 pricing_13p2) x 120 hosts. Scale target (Claude's flip condition): ~10^3 positives across 100+ hosts and several sectors. Sectors available for injection in Phase 3 are S95+S96 only (S97 held out, S98 locked); the 'several sectors' target is met in part -- the S97 hold-out is the third sector, reserved for validation rather than injection.

holdout_reason: S97 is the validation sector (P3-21) and the ranker's unseen-sector test (P3-18 names the distant-sector hold-out as the unseen-sector test). No S97 host is injected in Phase 3, so the hold-out stays unseen. S96 (+S95 for host count) carries the injections; S95 and S96 are the only sectors available for injection in Phase 3.

host_selection.note: Hosts are NOT pre-filtered for known signals (TOI/VSX): a host's own strong signal can win BLS over an injection (host confusion, seen in M-6). That is a measured effect, not a defect -- the screen record keeps the found period, so analysis can separate host-confusion non-recoveries from genuine losses. Pre-filtering would need per-star cone queries and would bias the host sample toward quiet stars.
host_selection.rule: Per inject sector: read the window file's TIC list, sort numerically, draw n_hosts without replacement with numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([master_seed, sector])). Same rule + same window file = same host list; the runner records each window file's sha256 in the run summary.

labels.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE is never a label (3/3). No trial in this campaign carries it; the runner's label validation rejects it. 'blend_photocopy' is a fine class for real leads in the 3A training design (P3-17); no injected trial uses it -- blends are a property of the host's neighbourhood, not of an injection.

locked_reason: S98 is LOCKED for the final blind evaluation (TB-8 / P3-21): do not rescore, score, or peek at it in Phase 3. The runner refuses S98 (and S97) as inject sectors.

period_distribution.note: Continuous LogUniform(0.5, 15) d -- NOT the discrete grid periods (5.123, 3.317, 2.17, 7.31 d), which a tree would memorise (Gemini, P3-10). Periods are drawn per trial from the per-host RNG, seeded by (master_seed, TIC, sector), so each host's trials are deterministic independent of the other hosts (parallel-safe, resume-safe).

splits.method: TIC-grouped by construction: split = hash-based assignment on the TIC alone (sha256 of '<master_seed>:<tic>'), so the same star's sectors never straddle train/test and the assignment does not depend on host-list order.

trial_templates.note: P3-13 pricing: injected planets at 13.1-13.3 d measure the cost of demoting the 13.2 d family. Labelled planet_like (they ARE planets); the kind flag marks them for the pricing analysis.
V-shaped (triangular profile) + odd/even depth difference + secondary eclipse at phase 0.5.
Sinusoidal variable across the SDE range; all 36 real EBs are high-SDE, so the astrophysical-FP class needs low-SDE coverage.

Instrumental artifact: the dip exists ONLY on cadences already carrying quality bits 29/30 in the host's real QUALITY column (TIME and QUALITY untouched; flux modified on flagged cadences only). The 18-artifact class from the S96 v2 gauntlet, injected.
